EventsView.description:
Which of a session's events a history request returns (client protocol
1.59.0; see [`crate::display_view`]).

oneOf.description:
What a transcript shows: bookkeeping left out, a superseded ACP
command list or tool presentation dropped, tool results without
their metadata, and a tool result over
[`crate::display_view::CUT_ABOVE_BYTES`] cut to its first bytes.

PageHeader.description: Which header an `events.page` answer carries (client protocol 1.64.0).

oneOf.description: The whole header of the page's first event.

Only what the client lacks of it: the client holds the header of the
window or page whose first event is `before`, and keeps those of its
events before the page's `older_cursor` that the answer holds no
event of the same sequence for.
None: the client reads into a gap and keeps the header it holds.

description:
Older history of a session, newest first, without a live tail (client
protocol 1.59.0).

before.description: The page holds events before this sequence.

header.description: Which header the answer carries (client protocol 1.64.0).
